# SnoutsWise

> SnoutsWise is a free, independent, sourced guide for dog owners. It explains dog breed groups (AKC and Royal Kennel Club), everyday care, health basics such as normal vital signs and vaccine schedules, reward based training and dog behavior, and offers a searchable table of foods dogs can and cannot eat, a science based dog age calculator and a chocolate dose estimator. Every page lists its veterinary, welfare or kennel club sources. SnoutsWise is a brand of Joshua Israel Ventures LLC, which owns and operates the site.

The content is general education, not veterinary advice; readers are told to contact a vet for individual dogs and emergencies.

## Guides
- [Dog breeds and breed groups](https://snoutswise.com/breeds.html): the seven AKC groups and seven Royal Kennel Club groups compared, and a checklist for choosing a breed
- [Dog care basics](https://snoutswise.com/care.html): feeding, healthy weight, exercise, tooth brushing, grooming, UK microchip law and heatstroke first aid
- [Dog health basics](https://snoutswise.com/health.html): normal temperature, heart and breathing rates, core vaccines and booster intervals, emergency warning signs, poisoning
- [Dog training](https://snoutswise.com/training.html): why vets recommend reward based training, how markers, luring and shaping work, first skills, tools to avoid
- [Dog behavior](https://snoutswise.com/behavior.html): stress signals, puppy socialization, the dominance myth and a general approach to problem behavior
- [Dog FAQ](https://snoutswise.com/faq.html): short sourced answers to common dog questions
- [Dog glossary](https://snoutswise.com/glossary.html): plain English definitions of dog care, health and training terms

## Tools
- [Can dogs eat this? food table](https://snoutswise.com/can-dogs-eat.html): searchable verdicts (toxic, caution, safe in moderation) with reasons, sources and what to do if eaten for about 70 foods
  - Categories: [Sweets and snacks](https://snoutswise.com/can-dogs-eat.html#sweets-and-snacks), [Drinks](https://snoutswise.com/can-dogs-eat.html#drinks), [Fruit](https://snoutswise.com/can-dogs-eat.html#fruit), [Vegetables](https://snoutswise.com/can-dogs-eat.html#vegetables), [Nuts and seeds](https://snoutswise.com/can-dogs-eat.html#nuts-and-seeds), [Meat, fish and eggs](https://snoutswise.com/can-dogs-eat.html#meat-fish-and-eggs), [Dairy](https://snoutswise.com/can-dogs-eat.html#dairy), [Grains and baking](https://snoutswise.com/can-dogs-eat.html#grains-and-baking)
- [Dog age calculator](https://snoutswise.com/dog-age-calculator.html): dog years to human years using human age = 16 ln(dog age) + 31 (Wang et al., Cell Systems 2020), with a table and limitations
- [Chocolate dose estimator](https://snoutswise.com/blog/dog-ate-chocolate.html): methylxanthine dose by chocolate type and dog weight, using Merck Veterinary Manual figures

## Games
- [Dog games hub](https://snoutswise.com/games/): three free original games, no sign up, no ads, no cookies
- [Snack or Nope?](https://snoutswise.com/games/snack-or-nope/): sort people foods into Safe, Caution or Toxic for dogs, with sources
- [Wag Signals](https://snoutswise.com/games/wag-signals/): dog body language quiz based on RSPCA and ASPCApro guidance
- [Fetch Spotter](https://snoutswise.com/games/fetch-spotter/): fetch timing game teaching which ball colors dogs see best (AKC)
